posts.title: My First Batch Post
posts.content: This is the first post in a batch. It's a great way to share multiple thoughts at once!

posts.title: Second Batch Post
posts.content: Batch posting lets you publish multiple posts efficiently. Each post goes through the same flow but automatically.

posts.title: Building Community Through Automation
posts.content: Automated posting is perfect for sharing research, updates, or regular content. You can schedule these batches on a cron job for continuous engagement!
